mentions.description: A 16×16 multiplication table (finite algebra with a single binary operation) that encodes quoting, evaluation, branching, recursion, an 8-state counter, and IO as lookups in the same table. Includes 83 Lean theorems verified with no gaps, found via axiom-driven SAT search (Z3) with Lean verifying the witness. Proves universal results for all satisfying algebras — every model is rigid, judgment and synthesis cannot commute, and the tester's acceptance partition carries irreducible information. The table fits in 256 bytes and can be recovered from a shuffled black-box oracle in 62 probes.
mentions.problem: Whether a finite algebra with a single binary operation can be forced by axioms to contain its own representation layer.
